authority: Root research-method review, collaboration message in this session

rules.grouping: Independent-reviewed exact connected components + numeric-normalized token-trigram Jaccard>=0.90; no low-overlap/tail/provenance unions
rules.calibration: Every C0 connected component CALIBRATION_ONLY, excluded from all main train/dev/heldout splits
rules.source_separation: No eligible live component touching native candidates in heldout
rules.count_shortfall: Report deterministic input-only counts and lower prospectively if needed, never relax duplicate rules after outcomes
rules.abstention: Only exact trimmed NO_CALL is explicit abstention; arbitrary no-attempt text described separately
rules.call_attempt: Syntax/name/parse independent attempts, malformed/unknown/empty/truncated reported separately in fixed denominators
rules.statistics: Descriptive finite-bank group-bootstrap CIs; no anti-cluster item-McNemar confirmation/equivalence/general safety claims
rules.quality_controls: Keep norm-matched random/permutation, relevant utility, invalid-output and KL gates; steering may validly fail dev gate
rules.novelty: Behavioral baseline replication; exploratory controlled transfer/steering extension
rules.before_main: Reviewed operator code/config/data/splits, checks and public prospective freeze
rules.before_heldout: Actual final source/config/splits/dev-selected fitted parameter hashes reviewed by root and explicit heldout gate file only root writes
